A screenshot of the team's error tracker and a backend request log, on one page.

Top bar: "Errors", "admin-web, production, release 3.18.0 (frontend unchanged since 29 Sep)", "Thu 1 Oct 2026, 08:00 to 12:00".

**Card 1, "Unhandled error":**
- Error: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')`
- Route `/forms/data-export`; events 412; users 97; first seen 09:41:12; last seen 11:58:40; events before 09:40: 0.
- Stack (source-mapped):
  - `renderControl` at `src/forms/FieldInput.tsx:35:29`
  - `FieldInput` at `src/forms/FieldInput.tsx:65:8`
  - "8 frames in react-dom (renderWithHooks, updateFunctionComponent, beginWork, ...)"

**Card 2, "Backend request log: POST /api/workspace-requests":** "All requests on 1 Oct, 08:00 to 12:00. Body as received; the last column is what the backend stored." Columns: time, status, request body, seats stored. Rows in order:
  - 08:47:19, status 201, body `{"workspaceName":"qa-load","seats":"20","region":"us-east","startDate":"2026-10-08","sso":true}`, seats stored 20
  - 09:12:55, status 201, body `{"workspaceName":"design-review","seats":6,"region":"eu-west","startDate":"2026-10-02","sso":true}`, seats stored 6
  - 09:40: highlighted marker row "config service: form configs v14 published"
  - 09:52:07, status 201, body `{"workspaceName":"ml-sandbox","seats":"51","region":"eu-west","startDate":"2026-10-05","sso":"true"}`, seats stored 51
  - 10:07:41, status 201, body `{"workspaceName":"payroll-qa","seats":4,"region":"us-east","startDate":"2026-10-12","sso":"true"}`, seats stored 4
  - 10:31:15, status 201, body `{"workspaceName":"growth-analytics","seats":"12","region":"eu-west","costCenter":"marketing","startDate":"2026-10-06","sso":"true"}`, seats stored 12
  - 11:15:02, status 201, body `{"workspaceName":"support-tools","seats":"5","region":"us-east","startDate":"2026-10-19","sso":false}`, seats stored 5

(For the interviewer: the `seats` values in the bodies are, in order, the string "20", the number 6, the string "51", the number 4, the string "12" and the string "5"; `sso` is the boolean true in the first two rows, the string "true" in the next three, and the boolean false in the last. The backend stored the seats as numbers 20, 6, 51, 4, 12, 5.)
